== Title ==
<span lang="ja">反撃</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">1フォース消費して、1ヶ所でのフォース消耗をキャンセルできる。その位置にいる敵のキャラクター、宇宙船、ビークルの合計枚数だけ運命数を引く。そして、自分の運命数の合計と、敵の戦闘力の合計を比較し、少ないほうが、その差だけのフォース消耗を受ける。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">帝国のストームトルーパーは、奇襲攻撃への対抗策として、即座に部隊を再編成し、一挙に形勢を逆転する訓練を受けている。これにより、ハン・ソロの型破りな追撃を阻止できた。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Counter Assault]].

'''Lore''' — Imperial stormtroopers train to regroup at once and reverse the situation in one move against a surprise attack. This let them stop Han Solo's unorthodox pursuit.

'''Game text''' — Use 1 Force to cancel a Force drain at one location. Draw destiny equal to the opponent's characters, starships, and vehicles there. Compare your destiny total with the opponent's power total. The player with the lower total suffers a Force drain equal to the difference.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore stresses immediate regrouping and reversing the situation. Game text uses フォース消耗 for both the canceled drain and the compared loss. English says the loser loses Force.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-D-counterassault.gif|Original English face]], [[Counter Assault]].</ref>
